meta.title: Static from the Driftwood Fleet
meta.instructions: Three scrambled messages from the rebel freighter, each in a new code where every letter stands for another. Tap a letter you think is in the message: right guesses unscramble everywhere (more copies, more points). Three wrong letters in one message and the signal dies. The navigator can tip you off twice. Crack all three before the Regency's jammer arrives.

enc.body: if c == ' ' or c == '' then '' else upper(get_or(cipher_key, (index_of(cipher_key, c) + 1) % 26, '?'))

key_state.body: if not has(guessed, letter) then 0 else if hits(letter) > 0 then 1 else 2

noise.body: upper(substr('qxzjvkwfyb', floor(hash(j * 7 + k * 13 + floor(now / 70.0)) * 10.0), floor(hash(j * 7 + k * 13 + floor(now / 70.0)) * 10.0) + 1))

do.to: if event.index == 0 then 'Tap a letter you think is in the message.' else 'New key. Same crew. Go.'

rules.when: event.letter != '' and not cracked and not busy() and not has(guessed, event.letter)

then.to: upper(event.letter) + ' appears ' + str(n) + (if n == 1 then ' time' else ' times') + '  +' + str(10 * n)

children.fill: = if has(guessed, char_at(k, j)) then '#5CF2C21F' else '#FFFFFF0D'
= if has(guessed, char_at(k, j)) then $primary else $secondary

children.text: = if has(guessed, char_at(k, j)) then upper(char_at(k, j)) else ''
= if busy() and not has(guessed, char_at(k, j)) then noise(k, j) else ''

children.color: = if has(guessed, char_at(k, j)) then '#8D9BE866' else $accent

art.style: A rebel freighter's comms console in deep space: navy void, pink and teal nebulae, amber console brackets, mint decoded letters.
